as_told.title: David Grusch calls Brent about how to approach Harrington

plain: David Grusch, a former intelligence officer turned UFO whistleblower, has named John S. Herrington, a former Reagan administration official and Secretary of Energy, as a key person who remembers a period whose records no longer exist, according to two Hollywood writers who tell it on the show. Brent Friedman says they 'identified John Harrington' as someone with 'oral history of a period where a bunch of documentation does not exist anymore', and describes a call about how to approach him. Bryce Zabel adds that, according to Grusch, many documents from the years when Herrington was active in the Reagan administration have gone missing. If true, Herrington's memory would be one of the few routes into that lost history.
